messages.author: 07beff09857fc2d4
messages.subject: Selectize remote Q
parts:
Is it possible to use a load parameter with selectize input to generate the drop down list from and external source(website)?

This doesn't work:

updateSelectizeInput(session, 'chars', choices = as.character(characteristics$value), 
                         options = list(render = I(
                           "load: function(query, callback) {
        if (!query.length) return callback();
        $.ajax({
            url: 'http://www.waterqualitydata.us/Codes/Characteristicname?mimeType=json',
            type: 'GET',
            dataType: 'json',
            data: {
                q: query,
                page_limit: 10
            },
            error: function() {
                callback();
            },
            success: function(char) {
                callback(char.value);
            }
        });
    }")),

Thanks,

Sam

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Selectize remote Q
parts:
Have you seen this example?
http://shiny.rstudio.com/gallery/selectize-examples.html

I don't think you need updateSelectizeInput(), and `load` does not
seem to be a sub-option of `render`.

Regards,
Yihui
